# netbox_l2vpns (Data Source)

Lists NetBox l2vpn objects (`/api/vpn/l2vpns/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_l2vpns" "all" {}

data "netbox_l2vpns" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "type", value = "vxlan-evpn" },
  ]
  limit = 50
}

output "l2vpns_names" {
  value = data.netbox_l2vpns.filtered.items[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/vpn/l2vpns/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name; validated against the parameters of the endpoint.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) All custom field values of the object as a JSON object (`jsondecode(...)`); selection values are unwrapped to the choice value and related objects to their ID.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `export_target_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Export Target (`netbox_route_target`). Defaults to an empty set.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `identifier` (Number) Identifier. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `import_target_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Import Target (`netbox_route_target`). Defaults to an empty set.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `slug` (String) Slug.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `active`, `planned`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `vpws`, `vpls`, `vxlan`, `vxlan-evpn`, `mpls-evpn`, `pbb-evpn`, `evpn-vpws`, `epl`, `evpl`, `ep-lan`, `evp-lan`, `ep-tree`, `evp-tree`, `spb`.
- `url` (String) Url.
